name: DUST '87
author: Lumina.Aerospace
description: Original 12-bit lo-fi drum sampler inspired by early-80s digital hardware. Features touch-first 48px+ targets, 4x3 swipeable pad banks, per-voice MIDI channels with combo fallback, interactive amp & pitch envelope displays, Q-Link MIDI learn, plate reverb, optional 64-step sequencer, and schema-validated presets with corrupt file quarantine.
